intro: v0.0.22 is about the lab and its scripted fights (#105, #110, #143, #150-#154). A spot-check round: each change says which Start > Debug > Scripts jump takes you there (start a new game, skip the call with START, then open the Start menu). Tick each change once you've seen it, and use the notes box for anything that feels off.
save: Save: old saves work (you start from the debug jumps this round anyway).

sections.title: The scripted fights (Debug > Scripts > 1, walk up into the lab, lose to Elm & Jenny)

items.title: Seen from Elm & Jenny's side (#105)
items.what: Elm and Jenny's Pokémon are on the near side with their picture at the start, and Oak is the opponent. When Oak talks, his picture slides in; Elm's, Jenny's and Ivy's lines show their portraits.
items.try: Lose the lab battle, say Yes to watching.

items.title: The fights play themselves (#105)
items.what: No pressing A during the scripted fights: the text moves on by itself.
items.try: Watch both fights without touching the buttons.

items.title: The gag is instant again (#105)
items.what: Oak's Lv 50 Pidgeot and Tauros hit straight away and flatten Elm and Jenny in one turn. No Agility, no Rest.
items.try: Say Yes to the second round.

items.title: No more flashing picture (#154)
items.what: The broken, multicoloured copy of the trainer's picture that flashed during attacks is gone.
items.try: Watch the attacks after Oak's line in the first fight.

sections.title: The rest of the lab (Debug > Scripts > 1)

items.title: Win, and you can still watch (#105)
items.what: Beat Elm and Jenny: Oak asks you first. After his fight (or a No), Elm wants his turn and you're asked if you want to watch them take on Oak, then the gag.
items.try: Win the lab battle, answer Oak, then say Yes to watching.

items.title: Facing Oak, and his Poké Balls leave the table (#150, #151)
items.what: You turn to face Oak when he asks to battle. When his starters battle (yours or Elm and Jenny's fight), their Poké Balls leave the table.
items.try: Look at the table after Oak's fight starts.

items.title: Quiet healing (#105)
items.what: No healing fanfare or extra message before the lab fights: Oak's lines say he heals you.

items.title: Oak points you to his aide (#152)
items.what: Before everyone leaves, Oak says his aide can answer anything about the project, the grant and the gadgets.

items.title: Debug jump 1 starts with no team (#153)
items.what: Using jump 1 again on the same game no longer keeps the Pokémon from your earlier try.
items.try: Jump 1 twice in a row and check your team.

items.title: Elm & Jenny wait left of the Pokémon Center (#143)
items.what: They stand side by side left of the Center, facing down, so you see their faces. Talk to either: Elm asks "Back for more?" (the rebattle; jump 15 played their first Pewter fight in v0.0.21, fixed).
items.try: Jump 15, look left of the Center.
